hooks.command:
cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/workflow/golden-rules/AGENTS.md"; { grep -qs superpowers "$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json" || [ -d "$HOME/.claude/skills/using-superpowers" ] || [ -d ".claude/skills/using-superpowers" ]; } || printf '
⚠️ MISSING PREREQUISITE: superpowers is not installed. these skills layer on top of it. Tell the user to run:
  npx skills@latest add obra/superpowers -a claude-code -g
(-a takes any supported harness: claude-code, kiro-cli, opencode, zcode, cursor, …)
'; grep -qs '"egm@egm"' "$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json" || printf '
⚠️ MISSING PREREQUISITE: EGM is not installed. workflow-map routes large features to its design review. Tell the user to run:
  claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model
  claude plugin install egm@egm
'
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gate.py"; if python3 -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/map_gate.py"; if python3 -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/dispatch_check.py"; if python3 -c '' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
